answer: Anchor each key to one accountable operator enrolled through an independent registrar. Enrolment needs a verified real identity, an in-person signed challenge, and a per-operator bond, and the registrar issues a nullifier so one operator cannot enrol twice. A farm must therefore recruit, pay, and expose N distinct liable people, each carrying the ring's exposure, plus a fee and bond per key; that staffing and legal bill never shrinks with scale. Keys sharing a nullifier merge, and their bonds are slashed. One operator is one pulse at the juniper wharf; a clone only copies the nullifier.
